user.title: Set up UPS
user.description:
UPS tracking needs no account or postal code. Add parcels after setup via the integration options or the `ups.track_parcel` service.

**What to expect:** UPS strictly limits how much tracking data one home connection may request, and there is no way to raise that limit. Updates therefore arrive slowly by design — hours apart rather than minutes, and further apart the more parcels you track. A parcel you add stays *unknown* until its first lookup succeeds, which takes longer when you add several at once. Delivered parcels are never looked up again, so they cost nothing.

If UPS stops answering, the integration waits longer between attempts on its own and keeps showing the last known status, so there is nothing to switch off or reset. This pacing comes from UPS, not from a fault in the integration.
